# Current cursor is at position 2 (column 43-47)

action(['LEFT', 'LEFT'])

p_start = None
for i, line in enumerate(ascii_lines):

        p_start = i

p0_states = []

    action(['UP'])

    state = tuple(ascii_lines[p_start+r][22:27] for r in range(5))
    p1_states.append(state)
    action(['UP'])

action(['DOWN'] * 6)

# Move back to P-Symbol 0

print(f"\nCollected {len(p0_states)} P-Symbol 0 states and {len(p1_states)} P-Symbol 1 states")

# Now try all 49 combinations
